basic_details.job_title: JNPA SEZ 2026 – Apply Offline for Manager Project and Fire Superintendent Recruitment Posts
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority Special Economic Zone (JNPA SEZ) has notified vacancies for Manager Project and Fire Superintendent posts on a contract basis, with applications to be submitted by speed post, registered post, or by hand to Chief Executive Officer, JNPA SEZ, Udhyam Bhavan, Sawarkhar, Uran, Navi Mumbai on or before 28 October 2026. This contract engagement has a tenure of two years. Eligible applicants must hold a Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, or a Degree in any discipline with an Advanced Diploma in Fire Engineering. The position offers a consolidated remuneration

qualification.details: Qualification: Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering (preferably Civil / Electrical / Mechanical / Infrastructure Engineering) from a recognized University or Institute in India. Experience: Minimum 20 years of experience working for Major Port/ industrial park/ SEZ/ shipping infrastructure organisation such as CFS, logistic park (of minimum capacity of 2 million TEU’s per annum) etc. in executive/ managerial cadre, out of total experience at least 05 years experience in the executive cadre of a pay scale Rs. 40,000 - Rs. 1,20,000 or above. Desirable experience in contract management, SAP, and GeM/CPP Portal. Age Limit: Maximum age 55 years for individual consultant or 65 years Maximum for Retired Port/ Govt. officers/ employees. Management may give relaxation for deserving candidates. | Qualification: Degree in any discipline and Advanced Diploma in Fire Engineering Or “M.I. (Fire – U.K.)” Or “M.I. (Fire – India)” OR A person holding a Higher Education Qualification in the subject of Fire Engineering. Membership of the Institute of Fire Engineers (India) is desirable. Experience: Minimum 5 years’ experience in port expert /State /Municipal /SPA Fire Department as Chief Fire Officer/Chief Fire Superintendent or Fire Superintendent. Age Limit: Maximum age 60 years for individual consultant or 65 years Maximum Retired Port/ Govt. officers/ employees. Management may give relaxation for deserving candidates.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must download the application format (Annexure-IV-B) from the official website, fill in the required details, attach self-attested copies of documents, and send the hardcopy by post or hand delivery. The application envelope must be superscribed as “Application for engagement of [Post Name] - Industry Professionals /Retired officers/ Government / Semi Govt. officers including Port fraternity Officers (in service / retired) on contract basis”. Postal Address: Chief Executive Officer, JNPA SEZ, Udhyam Bhavan, Sawarkhar, Uran, Navi Mumbai: 400707

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational and professional qualification certificates (starting from Diploma/Degree) Self-attested proof of date of birth Relevant employment and experience certificates “No Objection Certificate” from employer (for candidates serving in Government/ Semi Government, Public Sector Undertakings/ Autonomous Bodies) Details of two reference persons related to the field with contact details

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the posts is based on an evaluation criteria combining experience, qualifications, and an interview. Manager Project Evaluation Criteria: Experience (15 Marks: Port Sector = 15, Others = 10), Qualification (15 Marks: Diploma in Engg = 10, Degree in Engg = 15), and Interview (20 Marks). Fire Superintendent Evaluation Criteria: Experience (15 Marks: Port Sector = 15, Others = 10), Qualification (15 Marks: Advance Diploma in Fire Engg = 10, Degree in any discipline = 15), and Interview (20 Marks).

faq.question: Q1. Is this recruitment for permanent positions or on a contract basis?
faq.answer: These engagements are purely on a contractual basis for an initial period of two years, which may be extendable at the discretion of JNPA SEZ. The roles do not provide for regularization or permanency.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any additional allowances provided on top of the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: Yes, Manager Project receives a Transport Allowance of Rs. 20,000/- per month, and Fire Superintendent receives a Transport Allowance of Rs. 25,000/- per month, in addition to the consolidated remuneration.

faq.question: Q3. Can retired government or port officers apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Yes, retired port or government officers/employees up to the maximum age of 65 years can apply for both posts.

faq.question: Q4. Is email submission accepted for the application?
faq.answer: No, hardcopy submission of the application is mandatory. Applications sent only via email will not be considered.
